name: Demo login and Home access
expected: Home opens without frontend or network errors.

name: Settings privacy and navigation
description: Verifies the private account behavior and Settings destinations.
expected: Private account state is saved; visitor profile content and messaging are restricted; private live entry and gift MVP identity are anonymous; settings destinations work.

name: Wallet and creator workflow
description: Verifies wallet and creator money workflows submit backend requests.
expected: Backend requests complete or show validation.

name: Followers, Following and Friends are persisted
description: Verifies relationship tabs read durable backend data and follow/unfollow changes persist.
steps: Open Followers and verify the list loads from the backend
Open Following and verify the list loads from the backend
Open Friends and verify mutual follows are shown
Open Find Friends, follow a user, then unfollow the same user
Return to Following and refresh the list
expected: The relationship tabs show backend-backed data and the follow/unfollow state is persisted after navigation and refresh.

name: Account recovery
description: Verifies an account scheduled for deletion can be recovered within 30 days.
expected: Account is recovered within the 30-day window.

name: Live invite routing
description: Verifies the solo host Invite action starts the 1v1 PK request flow, while inviting a viewer as a guest opens the nine-seat guest room.
setup: Log in and start a solo live
steps: Select a live user and send the 1v1 invite
Verify the PK waiting/request flow reaches the pre-match screen
Start the PK match from the accepted request
Open a viewer action sheet and tap Invite as Guest
Verify the guest room contains one host seat plus eight guest seats
expected: The solo Invite action uses the 1v1 PK request/pre-match flow, and viewer Invite as Guest opens a nine-seat guest room.
